caption:
Lulu lifts overhead all day and loves a heavy bench. Lately the very top of the shoulder stings, especially reaching across the chest.

That spot is often the AC joint, where the collarbone meets the shoulder blade. Pushing through painful lifts can keep it irritated, so adjusting range and load usually helps more than stopping altogether.

Hybi's plan: shorten the range on bench and dips, add shoulder blade squeezes (5 seconds × 10), and keep pain at 3 out of 10 or lower.

If it started after a fall, wakes you at night or isn't improving after two weeks, an assessment comes first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 💪
